content.title: Future Students | McNeese State University
content.text: Find Your Fit With more than 100 academic programs and 100 student organizations on campus, there’s something for everyone at McNeese. Become a Cowboy today! Welcome to the Family Start exploring the tools you’ll use during the semester to ensure your academic success. Majors & Degrees Whether you have a clear career in mind or aren’t sure where the future will take you, McNeese makes it easy to find your professional fit. Get started by exploring a few of our most popular degree programs: Pay For School Navigating college costs can be daunting, but McNeese is here to help you through the process. Learn more about student loans, scholarships, grants and employment opportunities on campus. Life at McNeese With over 100 student organizations that represent a variety of academic, social, religious, political and professional interests, as well as events and celebrations throughout the year, there’s never a dull moment on campus. Explore more about what it means to be a Cowboy. Student Resources McNeese offers a variety of free on-campus and online resources available to help you succeed as a student, including tutoring in math, science, and English, as well as career advice and mentorship. Visit Campus & Take a Tour Interested in attending McNeese? Schedule a visit to campus or take a virtual tour to get an in-depth look at what we have to offer.
